name: github-ai-code-review
description: GitHub Action: Claude reviews a pull request diff with no tools and no credentials; the action validates the output and keeps one PR comment up to date.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
